ai_summary: AASTHA SPINTEX LIMITED's Q1 FY27 unaudited financial results indicate a significant quarter-on-quarter decline, with revenue dropping approximately 45% and net profit decreasing 71% compared to Q4 FY26, though profit did improve year-on-year. A material impact is the completion of a post-quarter Initial Public Offering (IPO) on July 6, 2026, which increased the company's outstanding share capital by nearly 40% and will dilute future earnings per share. While auditors issued a clean limited review report, the sharp sequential decline in operational performance presents a notable red flag for investors.
